en.title: Why Do Candle Flames Usually Point Up? | So That's Why
en.description:
For a candle under ordinary terrestrial gravity with weak imposed airflow, hot combustion gases are less dense than the surrounding cooler air. Buoyant flow carries them upward as cooler air moves in, shaping the familiar elongated flame. Microgravity greatly reduces this buoyancy-driven flow; low-momentum flames on the space station tend to be rounded or even spherical. en.title: Sapporo and Otaru: Ainu Clues in Written Place Names | So That's Why
en.description:
Two examples from Sapporo City and a Hokkaido Government exhibition. Sapporo has two proposed Ainu origins: a dry, broad place and a place with a large wetland. The city explains them through different terrain along the Toyohira River; this does not establish both etymologies as proven. The Otaru page links the name to the Otarunai River but says the meaning of Otarunai is unclear. The proposed beach meaning of ota is reported, not a settled translation of the whole name as sand river. The exhibition discusses sound-based kanji writing, later shortening and changed pronunciation, within the historical context of asserting Japanese territorial possession, rather than mere writing convenience. Clues are not a unique answer is our interpretation. This is not a rule for every Hokkaido name or a complete etymology lesson. ko.description:
Apple의 Face ID 수치는 하나의 외모만 등록했을 때 인구 집단 중 무작위로 선택한 다른 사람이 기기를 해제할 확률이 100만 분의 1 미만이라는 설명입니다. 같은 문단은 쌍둥이와 닮은 형제자매의 확률이 더 높다고 하며 이 집단의 구체적인 확률은 제시하지 않습니다. 기준을 쌍둥이, Pixel이나 모든 휴대전화에 그대로 적용하지 않습니다. 공식 설명을 읽는 것이며 자체 통계·해제 시험이 아닙니다. 설정 방법은 다루지 않습니다. 확인2026-10-01.
출처:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/102381
https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/9517039?hl=en

zh-CN.title: 百万分之一，条件不能省｜原来如此事务所
zh-CN.description:
Apple的Face ID数字限定只登记一种外观，以及从人群随机选取的其他人：误解锁概率低于百万分之一。同段说双胞胎与相似兄弟姐妹概率较高，没有提供这些群体的具体概率。不能把基准照搬到双胞胎、Pixel或所有手机。读的是官方说明，未做自己的统计或解锁测试；无设置教程。核查2026-10-01。
来源：
https://support.apple.com/en-us/102381
https://support.google.com/pixelphone/answer/9517039?hl=en

shorts.spoken: 百萬分之一，能直接當成雙胞胎的解鎖機率嗎？不能。蘋果對 Face ID 的說法，先限定只登錄一種外觀。再從人群中，隨機選一個其他人。這時誤解鎖的機率，低於百萬分之一。這個條件要和數字一起看。官方同時提醒，雙胞胎和長得像的手足，機率會更高。它沒有在這一段，公布雙胞胎的具體機率。所以不能替這個群體，照搬那個數字。也不能把蘋果的數字，拿來套到 Pixel 或所有手機。這裡讀的是官方說明，本片沒有做自己的統計測試。數字能幫你理解範圍，但省掉條件，就容易聽成另一個結論。
